description: Linemen sign in on the phone app. Staff sign in on this website.
read_only: View only: the app fee is not paid. You can see your team but not change it.
linemen_empty: No linemen yet. Add your first lineman.

status.no_password: Has not set a password yet

phones.title: Phones
phones.none: Not signed in on any phone yet.
phones.name: {model} ({code})
phones.sign_out_summary: {phone} will need the user name and password again. Payments saved on it stay on it.

form.name: Name
form.login_note: They type this to sign in. Usually the mobile number.
form.password_note_lineman: At least {min} letters or numbers. Not 123456, not the mobile number.
form.setup: How will they get a password?
form.setup_invite_note: They set their own password from the email.

added.title: {name} is added
added.password_note: Tell {name} the password yourself. It is not in the WhatsApp message.
added.login_changed: {suggested} was already used, so the user name is {login}.
added.invite_sent: We are emailing a link to {email}. It works for {minutes} minutes. After that, they can use "Forgot password?" on the sign-in page.
added.invite_failed: The email could not be sent now. They can use "Forgot password?" on the sign-in page with {email}.

reset.title: New password for {name}
reset.note_lineman: {name}'s phone will be signed out. {name} signs in again with the new password.
reset.note_staff: {name} will be signed out of the website and signs in again with the new password.
reset.done_lineman: {name}'s phone is signed out. Tell {name} the new password.
reset.done_staff: {name} is signed out. Tell {name} the new password.

switch_off.title: Switch off {name}?
switch_off.summary_lineman: {name} can't sign in any more, and the phone is signed out now. Old payments and history stay. Payments still saved on the phone stay there and are not lost. Best: switch off after {name} has handed over the day's money.
switch_off.summary_staff: {name} can't sign in any more and is signed out now. Their work stays.

email.required: Write the email to send the link to.
email.invalid: This email does not look right.
email.taken: Someone already uses this email. Use another email.

login.too_short: The user name needs at least 3 letters or numbers.
login.too_long: The user name is too long.
login.bad_characters: Use only letters, numbers, dot (.), dash (-) or underscore (_). No spaces.
login.taken: Someone else uses this user name. Try another one.
login.in_team: This person is already in your team.

password.too_short: Use at least {min} letters or numbers.
password.too_simple: This password is too easy to guess. Try another one, or tap "Make one for me".
password.same_as_login: The password can't be the user name or the mobile number.

error.not_owner: Only the owner can change the team.
error.tenant_read_only: View only: pay the app fee to change the team.
error.not_found: This person or phone was not found. Reload the page.
error.owner_account: Your own account is not changed here.

email.invite_intro: {business} added you to {app}. Your user name is {login}. You can also sign in with this email.
email.invite_action: Set your password here (the link works for {minutes} minutes):
email.invite_later: If the link stops working, open the sign-in page and tap "Forgot password?".
